verdict.rationale: Choosing models automatically is a fair question for an AI code-review tool, but the evidence never documents cubic routing each task to the best model. Ultrareview is a separate deeper review mode the user triggers, which uses 'most capable review models'; that is not automatic per-task model selection. Connecting a ChatGPT or Claude Code subscription is a user choice of model source, not automatic routing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let the tool automatically pick the best model for each task
